name: Am I...
source:
You just came back from work, tired and happy, as your holiday finally starts. As you decide to sit down, read your favourite book and have some chillout session, you unconsciously fall asleep. Where will you wake up? What will happen?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11169]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
